questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It's motivation that leads to success.
options: A. Motivation is the key to success.
B. Motivation results from success.
C. Success is part of motivation.
D. Success is the reason for motivation.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “leads to success” = “is the key to success” Dịch nghĩa: Động lực là chìa khóa để đạt được thành công.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It was this place that he found his first part-time job.
options: A. It was his part-time job, which he found in this place.
B. It was his part-time job where he found in this place.
C. He found his part-time job right here in this place.
D. He found his part-time job where it was in this place.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Dạng nhấn mạnh “It was this place that …” = “He found his part-time job right here.” Dịch nghĩa: Chính tại nơi này anh ấy đã tìm được công việc bán thời gian đầu tiên của mình.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Joanna can earn 40 dollars a week as a gardener.
options: A. Joanna is a gardener, which can earn 40 dollars a week.
B. 40 dollars is the money, which Joanna can earn a week.
C. Joanna can earn a week 40 dollars.
D. It is 40 dollars that Joanna can earn a week as a gardener.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Cấu trúc nhấn mạnh “It is … that …” nhấn mạnh vào số tiền. Dịch nghĩa: Chính 40 đô la mỗi tuần là số tiền Joanna có thể kiếm được khi làm người làm vườn.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. In western countries, young people usually take a gap year before going to university.
options: A. While going to university in western countries, young people usually take a gap year.
B. After going to university in western countries, young people usually take a gap year.
C. In western countries, before going to university, young people usually take a gap year.
D. Young people often take a gap year so that they can go to university in western countries.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Câu C giữ nguyên nghĩa gốc: “Ở các nước phương Tây, thanh niên thường nghỉ một năm trước khi vào đại học.” Dịch nghĩa: Ở các nước phương Tây, trước khi vào đại học, thanh niên thường nghỉ một năm.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Some teens can get their allowance for the things they do in the house.
options: A. It is the allowance that some teens can get for the things they do in the house.
B. It is the allowance for the things teens do in the house, which they can get.
C. Some teens can be allowed to do things in the house.
D. Some teens are allowed to get their house.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dạng nhấn mạnh “It is ... that ...” Dịch nghĩa: Chính tiền tiêu vặt là thứ mà một số thiếu niên nhận được khi làm việc nhà.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It is Peter that showed Alex how to drive a motorbike.
options: A. Alex showed Peter how to drive a motorbike.
B. Peter showed Alex how to drive a motorbike.
C. He is Peter, who Alex showed how to drive a motorbike.
D. This is Peter, who Alex showed how to drive a motorbike.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “It is Peter that …” nhấn mạnh chủ ngữ “Peter”. Dịch nghĩa: Chính Peter là người đã chỉ cho Alex cách lái xe máy.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Teens should learn basic life skills to survive difficult situations.
options: A. It is basic life skills, who teens should learn in order to survive difficult situations.
B. It is basic life skills that teens should learn in order to survive difficult situations.
C. Teens should learn basic life skills, which survive difficult situations.
D. Teens, who should learn basic life skills, survive difficult situations.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Dạng nhấn mạnh “It is ... that ...” nhấn mạnh “basic life skills”. Dịch nghĩa: Chính những kỹ năng sống cơ bản là điều mà thanh thiếu niên nên học để vượt qua những tình huống khó khăn.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I am looking forward to seeing you.
options: A. I don't have time to see you.
B. I will try to find some time to see you.
C. I should find some time to see you.
D. I am expecting to see you.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: “look forward to doing sth” = mong đợi điều gì đó. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi đang mong đợi được gặp bạn.
